title: Как работать с иконками | SDDS CS
text:
Icons ship as a separate package @salutejs/plasma-icons and are used as regular React components.

Install: npm install --save @salutejs/plasma-icons

Import: prefer sized entry points @salutejs/plasma-icons/16, /24, or /36 so only imported components end up in the bundle. If an icon isn't available in all sizes, import it directly from @salutejs/plasma-icons instead.
Sized entry points set the base SVG asset: /16 = 16px base, /24 = 24px base, /36 = 36px base.

Size prop: icons support a `size` prop — xs = 16px, s = 24px, m = 36px. An icon imported from a sized entry point already has a matching default size (xs for /16, s for /24, m for /36).

Color: set via `color` prop. Defaults to var(--plasma-colors-primary). Accepts a CSS variable, currentColor, inherit, a plain color, or a CSS gradient.

className/style: icons accept className and style for spacing, alignment, animation.

Custom size: if xs/s/m don't fit, set width/height directly via `style` (e.g. { width: '1.5rem', height: '1.5rem' }) with color="inherit" — useful when the icon's size should follow its parent container rather than a design token.

AVOID: the package also exports a generic `Icon` component that takes an icon name string (`<Icon icon="iconApps" />`). Do NOT use this in application UI — it can pull every icon into the bundle. Always import the specific icon component directly.
